name: MuslimInk
author: fiqsr
changelog_id: Arsitektur Lokasi Dunia Dinamis via GitHub: Katalog lengkap 26 negara dan seluruh kotanya kini di-hosting di GitHub (api/countries.json), dengan seed offline in-app yang super ringkas dan opsi sinkronisasi satu sentuhan ('🌍 Sinkronkan Semua Negara...')
Optimasi Ukuran Paket Ekstrem: Penghematan memori signifikan menghasilkan ukuran paket .xtapp hanya 261.856 byte (di bawah batas 256 KB) dengan performa loading instan di X4 Pro
Dukungan Penuh Dwi-Bahasa (ID/EN): Nama negara internasional kini otomatis menyesuaikan bahasa aktif (Indonesia / English) saat dipilih di Pengaturan
changelog_en: Dynamic World Countries Architecture via GitHub: Full catalog of 26 countries with all major cities is now hosted on GitHub (api/countries.json), featuring an ultra-compact offline in-app seed with one-tap on-demand sync ('🌍 Sync All Countries...')
Extreme Package Size Optimization: Significant memory savings keeping the .xtapp bundle at only 261,680 bytes (comfortably under the strict 256 KB limit) for blazing-fast loading on X4 Pro
Full Bilingual Country Name Support: International country names seamlessly adapt to the selected active language (Indonesian / English)
